about: What the Angles audio library holds. Music entries carry the prompt each track was generated from; sound effects name the file they were taken from and its licence. tools/audio-library/build.mjs turns the files into the published library.
musicBrief: Instrumental only, no vocals or vocal samples. One steady tempo from start to finish, with a drum or percussion pulse a listener can tap along to. Start sparse. At about 20 seconds the drums and bass come in and the track opens up clearly; it lifts again at about 50 seconds. At least 100 seconds long. No long intro, and end on a held note rather than a fade.

sfx.description: A single very short tick, for one item appearing.
A single click, for something being selected.
A single soft pop, for something arriving on screen.
A switch flipping, for a setting or a state changing.
A short whoosh that ends on its peak, to bring something in.
A short whoosh that starts on its peak, to take something away.
A short rising sweep, to lead into a reveal.
A short falling sweep, for something closing or dropping away.
One low, solid impact, for a big number or a headline landing.
One firm knock, for a label or a verdict being applied.
A page turning, for moving on to the next part.
A small bright chime, for something succeeding.
A single clear ding, for a notification.
A short low sound, for something failing.
